items.source: A set of data consumed from an underlying query result. A Window is similar to Slice in the sense that it contains a subset of the actual query results for easier scrolling across large result sets. The window is less opinionated about the actual data retrieval, whether the query has used index/offset, keyset-based pagination or cursor resume tokens.
items.translation: 从底层查询结果中消费的一组数据。Window 与 Slice 类似，因为它包含实际查询结果的子集，以便于在大型结果集中进行滚动。该窗口对实际数据获取方式持较少的主张性态度，无论查询是使用索引/偏移量、基于键集的分页还是游标恢复令牌进行的。
